verdict.rationale: Firebase documents a natural-language chat interface in the console (Gemini in Firebase) for answers, code generation and troubleshooting, plus Crashlytics and messaging analysis. Its official MCP server lets AI clients such as Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code Copilot create and manage projects, manage Auth users and work with Firestore data through natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of NL operation, evidence that the in-console Gemini chat can perform operational actions rather than advise, and documented coverage of NL control beyond the listed services (e.g. deploys, rules).
